mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand growth) signals stronger economic growth expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-month window, or 20-day returns in expanding economies are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of UNRATE above 8.5% in the next month signals labor market tightening, prompting expectations of higher inflation and tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 8.5% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite UNRATE crossing above 8.5%, or the crossing does not precede returns by at least 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling FEDFUNDS rates below 1% and rising quarterly GDPC1 growth signals dual easing and growth momentum, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% AND GDPC1 growth rate (t-6mo to t-2mo) > 3%
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.05 over any 1-month window, or 5-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high GDPC1 growth and low CPIAUCSL inflation, sustained demand growth and stable prices signal peak growth expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 3% AND CPIAUCSL < 2% in the past month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite meeting late-cycle expansion criteria, or the regime conditions are not sustained for the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained crossing of INDPRO above 94.8 signals robust supply-side growth, reducing inflationary pressures and boosting investor confidence in production capacity, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-month window, or 20-day returns in supply-side expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in UNRATE above 8.5% and FEDFUNDS above 4.0% indicates dual labor and monetary tightening, amplifying inflation expectations and tightening policy, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8.5% AND FEDFUNDS > 4.0% in the next month
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive despite both proxies rising above thresholds, or thresholds are not met within the horizon.

candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rising in the past month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS rising, or the tightening cycle does not precede returns by at least 5 days.
